physics-killer-01.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
physics-killer-01.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-01.material: Otu ihe na-amalite site n'izu ike n'ebe A dị elu $50\,\mathrm{m}$ n'ụzọ roller coaster na-enweghị esemokwu. Ịdị elu nke ebe atọ n'ụzọ dị ka tebụl na-egosi: ebe B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, ebe C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, ebe D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Ọ bụrụ na e leghara ọgbụgba ikuku anya na $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ugboro ole ọsọ n'ebe C bụ nke ọsọ n'ebe B, na ọsọ n'ebe D?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.prompt: Otu ihe na-amalite site n'izu ike n'ebe A dị elu $50\,\mathrm{m}$ n'ụzọ roller coaster na-enweghị esemokwu. Ịdị elu nke ebe atọ n'ụzọ dị ka tebụl na-egosi: ebe B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, ebe C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, ebe D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Ọ bụrụ na e leghara ọgbụgba ikuku anya na $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ugboro ole ọsọ n'ebe C bụ nke ọsọ n'ebe B, na ọsọ n'ebe D?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.explain: Ebe ihe ahụ na-ezu ike n'ebe A, site na $mgh_A=\frac12mv^2+mgh$ anyị nwere $v=\sqrt{2g(h_A-h)}$. $v_B=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot5}=10$, $v_C=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot20}=20$, $v_D=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot45}=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ya mere $v_C/v_B=2$ ugboro, $v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ọsọ adabereghị n'ịdị elu e rịdatara n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ, ọ na-adabere na $\sqrt{\Delta h}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ①); ọ bụrụ na e were ịdị elu D $5\,\mathrm{m}$ dị ka ịdị elu e rịdatara, a ga-enweta $10\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ③); ọ bụrụ na e hapụ $\frac12$, a ga-enweta $\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ④).
